content:
tara_csm: Quick heads-up: last night some trial/onboarding flows saw intermittent VPC auth 401s and slower-than-usual embedding responses. We need an interim customer-safe status update + targeted outreach for near-renewal trials. Can someone draft?

rohit_ops: Root cause analysis in progress. Early signal points to a cache compaction change combined with an ingestion spike that produced premature token evictions and a retry storm. Pushed a rollback + hotfix to add backpressure and a short-term auth circuit-breaker. Currently monitoring.

incident_bot: Hotfix deployment initiated by rohit_ops at 2025-04-02T03:18Z. Canary checks passing.

leah_support: Can CS get the roster of affected tenants and renewal dates? We should segment outreach: high-touch (exec + credit), standard (credit + onboarding slot), low-touch (note + optional session).

tara_csm: Pulling now. High-touch trials with renewals in 21-45 days: OrionMed, BlueCart, SyntaxAI. Mid: DataHarbor, OptiDocs, AtlasRetail. Low: ForgeSec, NimbleForms.

sam_sales: For high-touch, agree on exec escalation + 1-month credit + two priority onboarding consultations. For others, 1-month credit or equivalent service hours. Need finance signoff.

jen_finance: We can pre-approve one-month credits for trial customers impacted if CS tags them as "priority". Please include explicit language about how credit is applied (next invoice or refund).

rohit_ops: Technical summary for customer note: a configuration change to background cache compaction reduced token residency during high write bursts. Some sessions experienced auth failures; client retries increased pressure and caused embedding latency. Mitigations implemented: reverted compaction change, added cache headroom while we tune compaction, introduced short-term retry throttles, and added an auth-failure alarm. We'll follow with a detailed timeline and a full technical RCA.

tara_csm: Draft interim message below (please review for tone and legal):

```
Hi <Customer>,

We want to make you aware of a service disruption that may have affected onboarding flows on 2025-04-01. Some customers saw authentication errors or delayed embedding responses, which may have impacted your evaluation or ramp.

What happened (short): A background cache compaction configuration interacted with a burst of onboarding traffic, which led to some sessions losing token state and producing authentication errors and retries.

What we did: We reverted the compaction change, applied a hotfix to add cache headroom and retry throttles, and are monitoring closely.

Compensation & next steps: For affected trials were offering a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent onboarding support hours. If you are in an active renewal period, we will prioritize your environment for 30 days and schedule priority onboarding sessions.

Full RCA and timeline: we'll deliver a detailed technical report within 48 hours and run optional office hours to walk through the findings. Your CSM will follow up with a personalized plan.

Thank you for your patience. Please reply to this message or contact your CSM to schedule a session.

— Redwood Customer Success
```

leah_support: Language looks good. Add a short line: "If you experienced a failure, please share the example request ID(s) and approximate time so we can correlate logs."

tara_csm: Added. sending template to impacted list in 90 minutes unless objections. tagging finance for approval on credit language.

sam_sales: :thumbsup: for send. I'll prepare exec note for OrionMed/BlueCart/SyntaxAI and loop in their AEs.

jen_finance: :thumbsup: Approved as written. Please ensure credits are logged under ticket #CS-7842 for reconciliation.

rohit_ops: Fix confirmed stable at 2025-04-02T03:48Z. We'll maintain elevated monitoring for 72 hours, and we'll alert CS immediately if error rates rise. Full RCA ETA 48 hours.

tara_csm: Plan: 1) send interim note to impacted trials in 90m; 2) schedule priority onboarding sessions within 7 days for prioritized accounts; 3) deliver full RCA in 48h; 4) follow-up office hours within 5 business days. Proceeding unless I see objections. React :thumbsup: to proceed.

leah_support: :thumbsup:

sam_sales: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident class set to P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
